features.quote: Max model turns: 25–40. Max test runs: 12–20. Max wall time: 30 minutes. Max edit operations: 50.
Stop when any of the following occurs: 1. Agent declares completion. 2. Agent declares likely impossible/harness issue and stops.
Do not force the model to continue forever after it has rationally concluded the task is impossible. That can make the eval artificial.
features.justification_quote: That can make the eval artificial.

features.quote: Agent makes destructive changes or violates sandbox policy.
